race.comment: THEY'REALLSISTERS (1) flew over the top to score an impressive return win a fortnight ago. She resumed without a trial and should derive plenty of benefit with that run under her belt. Likely to be in the second half of the field again, though she's a nice horse on the rise and can repeat the dose. TRICKSTER (7) stuck on well on debut at Pinjarra over this distance, running on from midfield to miss out by 0.5L as the race fave. Expecting him to be better for that effort and he's shown good ability early in his career. He can play a leading role at his second start. GOD'S HAMMER (9) jumped favourite on debut in a similar race after some nice trials where he pulled up with an issue. His latest trial suggests he hasn't gone backwards and Pike sticks with him from that latest trial. Resumes as a gelding now and can play a leading role. GODSPEED (3) was super as fave last start and can feature again. COUNTERSUNK (2) can win again without surprising.
